name: Beispielregal (Bücher und Comic)
text:
# Sample shelf – origin and licenses

Generated by the build script `beispielregal.py`, which belongs to the maintainer's private
tooling and is not part of this repository. Do not edit by hand.

## Die Judenbuche (Droste-Huelshoff - Die Judenbuche.epub)

- Annette von Droste-Hülshoff (1797–1848), first published 1842. Text in the public domain.
- Source text: Insel-Verlag, Leipzig (11th–25th thousand), without the illustrations.
- Re-typeset; appendix “Personen und Orte” and cover: Akari, CC0.

## Kleider machen Leute (Keller - Kleider machen Leute.epub)

- Gottfried Keller (1819–1890), first published 1874. Text in the public domain.
- Source text: Gesammelte Werke, vol. 5, J. G. Cotta’sche Buchhandlung Nachfolger, Stuttgart and Berlin 1913.
- Re-typeset; appendix “Personen und Orte” and cover: Akari, CC0.

## Der Schimmelreiter (Storm - Der Schimmelreiter.epub)

- Theodor Storm (1817–1888), first published 1888. Text in the public domain.
- Source text: Ginn and Company, Boston 1908, text of the novella only.
- Re-typeset; appendix “Personen und Orte” and cover: Akari, CC0.

## Pepper&Carrot, episodes 1–3 (Pepper&Carrot – Folgen 1–3.cbz)

- Der Flugtrank · Regenbogentränke · Die geheimen Zutaten
- © David Revoy, https://www.peppercarrot.com – Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en
- German translation: Helmar Suschka (episodes 1–3), Alexandra Jordan (episode 3). Proofreading: GunChleoc (episodes 1–3), colognella (episode 3).
- Based on the universe of Hereva created by David Revoy with contributions by Craig Maloney. Corrections by Willem Sonke, Moini, Hali, CGand and Alex Gryson.
- Changed for Akari: episodes 1–3 combined into one file, images reduced, short strips (title, credits) joined to the neighbouring page, cover and this page added.

name: Beispiel-Cover (Vorschaudaten)
text:
# Sample covers – origin and licenses

Generated by the build script `beispielcover.py` (the maintainer's private tooling, not part of this repository); do not edit by hand.

The covers of the preview data (`-attrappen`). Each image was scaled to at most 600 px (JPEG); the Pepper&Carrot artwork was also cropped to 2:3, and the audiobook covers were padded to a square with a dark border. Public-domain scans are marked as such on Wikimedia Commons; Pepper&Carrot is licensed CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en

## Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus (frankenstein.jpg)

- title page of the first edition, vol. I (Lackington, Hughes, Harding, Mavor & Jones, 1818); Mary Shelley.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Frankenstein_1818_edition_title_page.jpg

## Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (alice.jpg)

- title page of the 1865 edition (Macmillan); Lewis Carroll.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:AlicesAdventuresInWonderlandTitlePage.jpg

## The Time Machine (time-machine-square.jpg)

- front cover of the first edition (William Heinemann, 1895); H. G. Wells.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Time_Machine_(Heinemann_text)_-_front_cover.jpg

## Pride and Prejudice (pride-and-prejudice.jpg)

- title page of the first edition, vol. I (T. Egerton, 1813); Jane Austen.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PrideAndPrejudiceTitlePage.jpg

## The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (holmes-adventures.jpg)

- cover of the first edition (George Newnes, 1892); scan by Rtrace and ΛΦΠ.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adventures_of_sherlock_holmes.jpg

## The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes (holmes-memoirs.jpg)

- cover of the first edition (George Newnes, 1894); scan by Rtrace.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Memoirs_of_sherlock_holmes.jpg

## The Case-Book of Sherlock Holmes (holmes-case-book.jpg)

- cover of the first edition (John Murray, 1927) by Joseph Van Abbé (J. Abbey, 1889–1954).
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Case-book-1927-murray-1st_edition.jpg

## Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas (twenty-thousand-leagues.jpg)

- illustrated Hetzel edition, Paris 1871, frontispiece by Alphonse de Neuville and Édouard Riou; digitised by the Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica).
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Illustrations_de_Vingt_mille_lieues_sous_les_mers_-_A._de_Neuville,_Riou,_dess._;_Hildibrand,_grav._;_Jules_Verne,_aut._du_texte_-_btv1b2200238g_(001_of_113).jpg

## Treasure Island (treasure-island-square.jpg)

- title page of the first edition (Cassell, 1883); Robert Louis Stevenson.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Treasure_Island_(title_page,_1883).webp

## The Jungle Book (jungle-book-square.jpg)

- cover of the first edition (Macmillan, 1894) by John Lockwood Kipling; Rudyard Kipling.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Jungle_Book_(1894)_cover.jpg

## Little Nemo in Slumberland (little-nemo.jpg)

- Sunday strip of 3 December 1905; Winsor McCay.
- License: Public domain.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Little_Nemo_1905-12-03.jpg

## Pepper&Carrot, episode 36: The Surprise Attack (pepper-carrot-36.jpg)

- © David Revoy, https://www.peppercarrot.com.
- License: CC BY 4.0.
- Source: https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/webcomic/ep36_The-Surprise-Attack.html

## Pepper&Carrot, episode 37: The Tears of the Phoenix (pepper-carrot-37.jpg)

- © David Revoy, https://www.peppercarrot.com.
- License: CC BY 4.0.
- Source: https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/webcomic/ep37_The-Tears-of-the-Phoenix.html

## Pepper&Carrot, episode 38: The Healer (pepper-carrot-38.jpg)

- © David Revoy, https://www.peppercarrot.com.
- License: CC BY 4.0.
- Source: https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/webcomic/ep38_The-Healer.html

name: Beispielinhalte (Vorschaudaten)
text:
# Mock content – origin and licenses

Generated by the build script `mockinhalte.py` (the maintainer's private tooling, not part of this repository); do not edit by hand. Used only by the sample mode
(`-attrappen`) for screenshots and tests, never in a real library.

## The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes – “A Scandal in Bohemia” (holmes-adventures.epub)

- Arthur Conan Doyle (1859–1930), first published in The Strand Magazine, July 1891. Text in the public domain.
- Re-typeset from a public-domain edition; the glossary “Characters / Places” is written for Akari, CC0.

## The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes – “Silver Blaze” (holmes-memoirs.epub)

- Arthur Conan Doyle (1859–1930), first published in The Strand Magazine, December 1892. Text in the public domain.
- Re-typeset from a public-domain edition, split into three parts; the glossary “Characters / Places” is written for Akari, CC0.

## Pepper&Carrot, episodes 1 and 2 (pepper-1.jpg … pepper-8.jpg)

- “The Potion of Flight” (pages 1–3) and “The Rainbow Potions” (pages 1–5), English original.
- © David Revoy, https://www.peppercarrot.com – Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en
- Based on the universe of Hereva created by David Revoy with contributions by Craig Maloney. Corrections by Willem Sonke, Moini, Hali, CGand and Alex Gryson.
- Changed for Akari: pages scaled to 1000 px width and recompressed.

## The Time Machine, chapter 1 (time-machine.m4a)

- H. G. Wells (1866–1946), first published 1895. Text in the public domain.
- Reading: LibriVox volunteers, https://librivox.org/the-time-machine-by-hg-wells/ – LibriVox recordings are in the public domain.
- Changed for Akari: an excerpt of about one minute from chapter 1, converted to AAC mono at 40 kbit/s.
